name: Vertical Tree Tabs
description: Vertical tabs in the side panel, nested as a tree under the tab each one was opened from.

_execute_action.description: Open the tree tabs side panel

find-tab.description: Find a tab in any window

toggle-tree.description: Collapse or expand the current tab's tree

collapse-all.description: Collapse every tree in the window

expand-all.description: Expand every tree in the window

new-child.description: New tab as child of the current tab

new-sibling.description: New tab next to the current tab, after the tabs under it

duplicate.description: Duplicate the current tab, next to it in the tree

top-level.description: Move the current tab to the top level

new-window.description: Move the current tab's tree to a new window

close-tree.description: Close the current tab and the tabs under it

new-folder.description: Move the current tab (or the selected tabs) into a new folder
